headlines.description: — Tyler Stephenson hit a three-run homer to highlight a five-run sixth inning, Jose Trevino, TJ Friedl and Sal Stewart also went deep and the Cincinnati Reds scored nine unanswered runs in a 10-8 win over the Chicago Cubs on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds hit 4 homers, score 9 unanswered runs to beat wild card-leading Cubs 10-8

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal threw six solid innings against his former team, Freddie Freeman hit a tiebreaking single in the seventh inning and the
headlines.shortLinkText: Tarik Skubal throws 6 solid innings in 1st start against former team, helping Dodgers top Tigers 2-1

headlines.description: — Brady House hit a three-run homer, Jackson Kent threw seven innings of one-run ball to pick up his first major league win, and the Washington Nationals beat the Miami Marlins 9-2 on Friday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Kent earns his 1st major league win as the Nationals beat the Marlins 9-2

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Hunter Brown struck out 10 and allowed a run over 6 2/3 innings, Daulton Varsho had a two-run single in a three-run sixth inning and the Houston Astros beat the New York Mets 3-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Varsho backs Brown in the Astros' 3-1 victory over the Mets

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Michael Wacha dominated Cleveland's lineup by allowing just four singles over eight innings as the Kansas City Royals stayed scorching hot with a 3-0 win on Friday night to end the Guardians' winning streak at seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Wacha dominates for 8 innings as Royals blank Guardians 3-0 for their 11th win in 12 games

events.name: San Diego Padres at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Yandy Diaz and Cedric Mullins each homered and drove in two runs and the AL-leading Tampa Bay Rays scored five runs in the fourth inning on the way to a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diaz, Mullins homers power AL-leading Rays to a 9-4 win over the Padres for 80th victory

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Paul Goldschmidt homered, left fielder Cody Bellinger threw out the potential tying run at home plate to end the seventh inning and the New York Yankees edged the Boston Red Sox 1-0 on Friday night in the opener of a pivotal four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees nip rival Red Sox 1-0 in series opener behind Goldschmidt, Bellinger and Schlittler

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II drove in three runs on two hits, including a homer, Ronald Acuña Jr. had three hits and three runs, and the Braves beat the Colorado Rockies 6-4 on Friday night...
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris homers, drives in 3, and Acuña has 3 hits as Braves top Rockies 6-4 for 5th straight win

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Dylan Cease struck out eight in six innings, George Springer was 4 for 4 with a home run, and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Seattle Mariners 8-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Cease strikes out 8 in six innings, Blue Jays hit 3 homers to beat Mariners 8-1

headlines.description: — Logan Henderson gave up one hit over seven innings and Jake Bauers reached base five times and scored twice in his return to the lineup as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Texas Rangers 6-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson allows 1 hit in 7 innings as the MLB-leading Brewers beat the Rangers 6-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit his 28th homer and Andrew Benintendi drove in two runs to help the AL Central-leading Chicago White Sox beat the Minnesota Twins 7-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery hits 28th homer in AL Central-leading White Sox's 7-4 win over Twins

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Quinn Mathews allowed one run over 5 2/3 innings for his first major league win and Jimmy Crooks hit a two-run homer to lead the St. Louis Cardinals to a 4-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals beat Pirates 4-1 as Quinn Mathews gets his first MLB win

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Edmundo Sosa hit his first career grand slam with two outs in the ninth inning, and the Philadelphia Phillies roared back for a 5-3 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edmundo Sosa's pinch-hit grand slam in 9th propels Phillies to a wild 5-3 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Coby Mayo and Christian Encarnacion-Strand had two-out RBI singles in the 10th inning and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Athletics 4-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayo, Encarnacion-Strand lift the Orioles past the Athletics, 4-3 in 10 innings

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Lars Nootbaar homered to center on the first pitch of the game and had three of Arizona’s 12 hits to help the Diamondbacks beat the San Francisco Giants 10-6 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nootbaar's leadoff homer, 3 hits spark Diamondbacks in 10-6 victory over Giants
